fields.title: AI-Driven Medical Image Processing for Early Brain Tumor Detection
fields.abstract: This paper proposes a deep learning model using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to detect early-stage brain tumors from MRI scans. The system achieves high accuracy in classification, significantly reducing diagnostic time for medical professionals.

fields.title: Real-Time Credit Card Fraud Detection Using Machine Learning Ensemble Models
fields.abstract: Fraudulent transactions pose a critical threat to modern financial networks. This research compares Random Forest, XGBoost, and Isolation Forest algorithms to analyze highly imbalanced transaction datasets and detect fraudulent patterns in real time.

fields.title: Smart Agriculture Telemetry System using ESP32 Microcontroller and Blynk Cloud
fields.abstract: An IoT-based environmental monitoring framework designed to capture real-time soil moisture, temperature, and humidity levels. The telemetry data is transmitted to a cloud server to automate agricultural irrigation systems.

fields.title: Automated Unit Test Case Generation for Django Web Applications
fields.abstract: Manual test writing slows down agile deployment pipelines. This project introduces a static code analysis tool that automatically extracts API endpoints and model schema to generate unit test files for Django applications.

fields.title: Network Intrusion Detection in Cloud Environments Using Deep Autoencoders
fields.abstract: As cloud migration accelerates, traditional firewalls struggle against complex cyber threats. This study develops an unsupervised deep learning model to identify zero-day network attacks and unusual bandwidth anomalies in cloud infrastructure.

fields.title: Natural Language Processing for Automated Bengali Essay Scoring
fields.abstract: Automated essay evaluation systems are predominantly designed for English. This research introduces a Bengali transformer model (BERT-based) to grade student essays based on grammar, semantic relevance, and structural cohesion.

fields.title: Optimization of Real-Time Physics and Rendering Performance in Mobile 3D Racing Games
fields.abstract: Mobile devices face memory constraints when rendering complex 3D assets. This paper analyzes draw call optimization, level-of-detail (LOD) techniques, and rigid-body physics tuning in the Unity game engine for Android builds.

fields.title: Autonomous Vehicle Lane Detection and Obstacle Tracking in Low-Visibility Conditions
fields.abstract: Fog and heavy rain severely impair optical cameras in self-driving cars. This project presents a hybrid approach integrating thermal vision processing and LiDAR point-cloud mapping to maintain accurate lane tracking.

fields.title: Decentralized Academic Certificate Verification Protocol on Ethereum
fields.abstract: Paper certificates are prone to forgery. This project implements a decentralized application (DApp) utilizing Smart Contracts to verify student degree credentials immutably on a public blockchain ledger.

fields.title: Explainable AI in Early Disease Detection using Deep Learning
fields.description: This research focuses on developing interpretable deep learning models for medical image diagnosis (e.g., MRI, X-ray). The primary objective is to enhance model transparency, allowing medical practitioners to understand the decision-making process of diagnostic AI tools.
fields.prerequisites: Strong background in Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Computer Vision basics, and Data Analysis techniques.

fields.title: Microservices Architecture Optimization for Scalable Web Applications
fields.description: The goal of this project is to analyze performance bottlenecks, latency issues, and inter-service communication efficiency in containerized microservices. The candidate will design a lightweight API gateway pattern and benchmark modern orchestration tools under heavy user traffic.
fields.prerequisites: Good knowledge of Django/Node.js, Docker, RESTful API design, PostgreSQL, and basic understanding of System Architecture.

fields.title: Automated Brain Tumor Detection and Classification from MRI Images Using Hybrid Deep Learning Models
fields.description: This research project focuses on designing an automated and explainable computer vision framework to segment and classify brain tumors (e.g., glioma, meningioma) from MRI scans. The primary goal is to combine Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with statistical feature extraction to improve diagnostic accuracy and assist medical specialists.
fields.prerequisites: Knowledge of Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Computer Vision (OpenCV), Image Processing, and basic Machine Learning algorithms.
